leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: Written notice shall be given to the building principal when it is known in advance that the certified employee will be unable to perform his/her duties satisfactorily. The notice shall indicate the medical reason and the approximate dates of expected absence.
leave_absence_reporting_013.coder_notes: Changed from 'no'/'not_discussed' to 'yes'. Article X, Section E explicitly specifies the procedure for reporting teacher absences (written notice to the principal with medical reason and dates), directly addressing the 'absence reporting' part of the question. Stage 1 missed this passage.
